newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Filinvest realty units boost 9-mth net.
newsitem.headline: Filinvest realty units boost 9-mth net.

text.p: Philippine holding company Filinvest Development Corp said its two real estate subsidiaries contributed much of the impressive 556 percent net income growth in the first nine months of the year.
Filinvest posted a net income of 2.9 billion pesos in the first three quarters as against 442 million pesos in the same period last year, the company reported on Tuesday.
Revenues grew to 5.0 billion pesos from 1.15 billion pesos registered in the first nine months last year.

"This accelerated growth is mainly due to the superlative performances of two of our subsidiaries: Filinvest Land Inc through its outstanding sales of housing units and Filinvest Alabang Inc through its robust sales of properties from the Filinvest Corporate City," it said in a statement.
Residential housing developer Filinvest Land earlier reported a turnover of 1.8 billion pesos in the first nine months of the year.
